newsitem.title: USA: Former U.S. Senator Sam Nunn joins GE board.
newsitem.headline: Former U.S. Senator Sam Nunn joins GE board.

text.p: Sam Nunn, who retired last week after 24 years in the U.S. Senate, was named to the board of the General Electric Co., the company said on Monday.
The appointment of Nunn, 58, brings membership on GE's board to 15.
Nunn, a Georgia Democrat, decided against running for re-election after completing his fourth term on January 3.
He was the chairman and ranking Democrat on both the Senate Armed Services Committee and the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations.
GE is one of the world's biggest diversified manufacturing, services and technology company.
